# Warp News

> Warp News is a fact-based optimistic news platform countering doom-scrolling with verified stories of human progress, innovation, and positive global trends.

Founded by Mathias Sundin (The Angry Optimist), Warp News curates evidence-based articles about scientific breakthroughs, environmental recovery, health innovations, and human progress. The platform offers free weekly newsletters and premium content through its Optimist's Edge membership.

## Key Topics

- Fact-based optimism
- Human progress
- Scientific breakthroughs
- Health technology
- Environmental recovery
- AI innovation
- Vaccine development
- Climate action
- Species recovery
- Optimist's Edge
- The Angry Optimist
- Mathias Sundin
- Positive global trends
- Newsletter
- Premium content

## Health & Medical Innovation

- [🧒 First vaccine that protects children from deadly E. coli infections](https://www.warpnews.org/health-tech/first-vaccine-that-protects-children-from-deadly-e-coli-infections): Article on ETVAX vaccine reducing infant diarrhea by 68 percent
- [👁️ Small chip in the eye restores sight to the blind](https://www.warpnews.org/health-tech/small-chip-in-the-eye-restores-sight-to-the-blind): Article on PRIMA retinal implant restoring vision in 26 of 32 patients
- [🔍 AI agent screened nearly 2,000 genes and found new pathways](https://www.warpnews.org/health-tech/ai-agent-screened-nearly-2-000-genes-and-found-new-pathways-against-gut-disease): Article on Eubiota AI discovering DNA repair mechanisms in gut bacteria
- [🍺 GLP-1 drugs like Ozempic reduce risk of substance abuse](https://www.warpnews.org/health-tech/glp-1-drugs-like-ozempic-reduce-risk-of-substance-abuse-and-addiction): Article on GLP-1 drugs reducing substance abuse and overdose deaths

## Environmental & Climate Progress

- [🌲 Sweden's forests are growing – every harvested tree is replaced](https://www.warpnews.org/human-progress/swedens-forests-are-growing-every-harvested-tree-is-replaced-with-two-to-three-new-seedlings): Article on Sweden's forest growth doubling since 1920s
- [📈 UK emissions at lowest level since 1872](https://www.warpnews.org/green-tech/uk-emissions-at-lowest-level-since-1872): Article on UK emissions falling 54 percent below 1990 levels
- [🦬 European bison have increased from 60 to 9,000 species](https://www.warpnews.org/human-progress/european-bison-have-increased-from-60-to-9-000-now-the-species-expands-to-spain): Article on European bison recovery and reintroduction in Spain

- [⚙️ Forced labor has nearly disappeared in the world](https://www.warpnews.org/human-progress/forced-labor-has-nearly-disappeared-in-the-world): Article on global forced labor abolition from 165 to 9 countries
